steps.name: preflight
argv:
# GUARD, NOT A VARIABLE. Carried from the parent and EXTENDED to the two
# references: --controlnet points at a local directory, so the sidecar can only
# record a path, and every input that conditions this frame is re-read here
# before a GPU second is spent.
import hashlib, os, sys
d = r"C:\banyan-farm\cnet-openpose-twins"
blob = os.path.join(d, "diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors")
n = os.path.getsize(blob)
if n != 2502139104:
    print("!! twins blob is %d bytes, expected 2502139104" % n); sys.exit(1)
h = hashlib.sha256()
with open(blob, "rb") as fh:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 22), b""):
        h.update(chunk)
got = h.hexdigest()
if got != "54a2afb1bd21349e475566e5428884bc937a4caecf863b29dea08acc40612fa4":
    print("!! twins blob sha %s, expected 54a2afb1bd21349e475566e5428884bc937a4caecf863b29dea08acc40612fa4" % got); sys.exit(1)
ch = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(d, "config.json"), "rb").read()).hexdigest()
if ch != "b5b8f9a7619c9452f19407ef73a01ce3f061fcf932de43ddbaca336d12d02801":
    print("!! twins config sha %s, expected b5b8f9a7619c9452f19407ef73a01ce3f061fcf932de43ddbaca336d12d02801" % ch); sys.exit(1)
bad = [r for r, _, fs in os.walk(d) for f in fs if f.endswith(".incomplete")]
if bad:
    print("!! .incomplete under the twins dir: %r" % bad); sys.exit(1)
for rel, want in (("pipeline/controlnet_plate.py", "33c438163ce1314ff989f337e9472f08dcbabd5815cb096527e20e13631b7f7a"), ("pipeline/control/b08-openpose-nat-0819.png", "562911c8174a6ecc21bc8710a1ac1b7f965c3f2d865093a742c2598c37d952e0"),
                  ("pipeline/control/b08-ref-goblin-0819.png", "13b0c69d2f95dad6fd5472d8ab0310967b1a88c4554de7e6ff74b2d3e3644d8c"), ("pipeline/control/b08-ref-guard-0819.png", "61dc3f7fbd052617e52db63e8f6d359822b6ceba14b13514ffc03179b56cd83c")):
    p = os.path.join(r"C:\banyan-farm\b08twinsipa-0819\src", rel.replace("/", os.sep))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        print("!! staged file missing: %s" % p); sys.exit(1)
    hh = hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    if hh != want:
        print("!! %s sha %s, expected %s" % (p, hh, want)); sys.exit(1)
print("twins net verified: %d bytes, sha %s" % (n, got))
print("staged driver, hint and BOTH references verified")

steps.name: publish
argv:
# box_enqueue.courier_problems: the courier pushes from farm-out and
# nowhere else, and ep2-cnet-probe-0817 was invisible for two days for
# want of exactly this step.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08twinsipa-0819/out"
pay_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08twinsipa-0819"
ctl_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08twinsipa-0819/src/pipeline/control"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b08-twinsipa-0819"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep2-b08-twinsipa-0819-twinsipa.png*")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/negative.txt")
               + glob.glob(ctl_dir + "/b08-openpose-nat-0819.png")
               + glob.glob(ctl_dir + "/b08-ref-*-0819.png"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b08-twinsipa-0819.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 7 else 1)
